name: sgs/site-footer-row
title: SGS Footer Row
description: One row of a site footer — either a never-overflow cluster (top strip / bottom bar) or a column grid (up to 6 columns collapsing to 1 below the mobile tier). Lives inside sgs/site-footer.

sgs._intrinsicColumnsComment: D456 — the column count becomes a CEILING that degrades with available width, instead of a fixed count that only changes at a viewport breakpoint. Measured live before this change: all three footer rows dropped 3 tracks to 1 between viewport 768px and 767px, while their content needed just 496px of the 767px available. A @media rule cannot read content size, so that collapse could never be organic. Opt-in per block type, read by sgs_block_wants_intrinsic_columns().

layout._comment: D456-follow-up (2026-08-02) — same shape + same latent exposure as sgs/site-header-row's `layout` enum (see that block.json for the full rationale): `class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:528` only routes the shared wrapper's gap onto the query-container-ancestor `.sgs-container__inner` when layout is 'flex' or 'grid'. This row's own gap defaults are plain px today (not cqi), so the landmine has no live symptom here yet — but the enum closes it universally rather than leaving a per-block carve-out (R-31-9), so a future cqi-based gap value on this block can never resolve against the wrong container either. Verified: edit.js LAYOUT_OPTIONS, render.php, and every theme pattern instantiating this block use only 'flex'/'grid'.
